displayIdentity.body: Freedom seeks another person’s good and God’s glory. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up. even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.
